thread:
sophie: hey all — quick async: I sketched the v2 deprecation rollout timeline and want to confirm owners for each lane before I send to legal/pm. TL;DR: four lanes (SDK, runtime, infra, docs/migrations). can owners ack?

jin: yo, I can take SDK owner unless someone else already volunteered. what does ownership mean here? brief checklist?

sophie: thanks. checklist = PR merge + release note + a small canary that verifies header compatibility. also triage any client-side fixes for header naming.

maura: runtime can take the runtime lane. we'll need a short smoke that verifies schema fallback and a KV cache compatibility test.

ranjit: infra (routing + capacity) here. I'll coordinate the canary slices and fallback routing policy. need to know expected traffic % and time windows.

tanya: docs + migration guides here. i'll draft the migration checklist and a one-pager for customer success. will need SDK PR diffs from jin to include.

jin: perfect. i'll list the SDK PRs: #8421 (header mapping), #8470 (response shape shim). planning to cut a canary build tomorrow.

sophie: can we confirm a small canary command for infra to wire up? e.g.

```
# canary: route 1% -> v2-compat with fallback
redwood route set --slice canary --percent 1 --target v2-compat --fallback v1
```

ranjit: that's fine. i'll schedule a 1% slice for 6h starting tomorrow 03:00 UTC. will add a flag so we can ramp/kill quickly.

maura: runtime smoke: we'll run the following in CI: gen 100 short requests and validate tokenization + rolling kv hits >= 90%. snippet:

```
python tests/smoke_v2.py --requests 100 --assert-kv-hitrate 0.9
```

sophie: thanks. two open questions: 1) should we keep the SDK header shim alive for 90 days post-cutover? 2) who signs off on SLA rollback docs?

jin: 90 days sounds right. we'll add a feature flag `compat:header_shim` default on and schedule removal ticket.

ranjit: SLA rollback docs: infra + runtime to co-author, ops reviewers from SRE. i'll loop in @oncall when we have the draft.

tanya: for docs timeline: i can publish a draft migration guide the morning after canary completes. need example responses from runtime to show the shim behavior. jin/maura pls attach.

sophie: action items: 1) jin: post the SDK canary build link and PR list by EOD. 2) maura: add smoke CI job and share job link. 3) ranjit: schedule 1% slice and add rollback playbook stub. 4) tanya: draft guide and include examples. i'll assemble owners doc and send to legal/pm for notice copy.

jin: acked — will ping here once build is up. :thumbsup:

maura: ack, adding CI job now.

ranjit: acked, i'll create infra ticket and tag SRE.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: infra-ticket #5912, canary window 2024-11-07T03:00Z -> 2024-11-07T09:00Z, owner @ranjit.

sophie: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll update the owners doc and post the short rollout plan later today. feel free to drop quick notes here if blockers pop up. :raised_hands:
